title: Kings of the South and North

reflections.title: "The people who know their God"

reflect.text: Knowing God is the greatest knowledge we can ever have, and it is the true source of our strength. When we learn who Jesus is through Scripture and walk with Him each day, our trust in Him deepens. As Charles Spurgeon noted, "the more we know him, the more we shall love him." This knowledge wipes away our ignorance, fills us with a sure hope for the future, and gives us patience to endure hard times because we know Christ's gentle care.

When dark times come and others compromise, people who know their God stand firm. Fellowship with God shapes us to be more like Him. When we look to His mighty power and unending faithfulness, human threats seem small. Knowing that the Lord stands behind us like a wise, faithful friend brings peace to our hearts. We do not learn about God just for our own curiosity, but so that we have the courage to step out, resist evil, and serve Him boldly.

questions: How does spending time getting to know Jesus change the way you face difficult situations?
Where in your life today do you need God's strength to stand up for what is right?
reflections.prayer: Lord God, please teach us more of who You are so that our faith and love may grow. Help us to walk closely with You each day, resting in Your power and faithfulness. Give us courage to stand firm for Your truth and to obey You without fear. Amen.

D4.author: Alistair Begg (Truth for Life)
